name: Wilson
gaps: Geometry and owner are Tennessee OIR Tennessee Property Boundaries Public Use, edited 2026-09-10, filtered by Comptroller COUNTY_ID. Acreage is the geodesic area of the polygon because DEEDAC is often 0. The filter is 5.0–150.0 acres inclusive. Vertices are not simplified.

Sale date, sale price, and appraisal are joined on GISLINK and labeled 2023 in the popup when a value is present. A GISLINK with no match is left without sale or value. Assessed value, taxable value, and tax amount are not on the TN_County_Parcel_Map join.
The property-record link is LINK_TPAD when the OIR row publishes it, otherwise the TPAD GIS card for the same GISLINK. Opportunity Zone status was not inferred.
Regrid and other paid parcel vendors were not used.

Wilson has no countywide zoning layer. Lebanon and Mt. Juliet zoning are stamped only where the centroid falls in those city polygons. Mt. Juliet future land use is the same kind of city-only stamp. Cookeville is not in Wilson.
